title: Launcher slice four: one Setup item per Space tool (booking, product, memberships, donations, campaigns, capture links, automation), with a coverage test

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-29: every key product has its check-off steps

detail: After Publish the Get Started list adds Money and Reach sections whose items are done only when a real record says so (availability, products, tiers, donation asks, campaigns, capture links, automations) and open the Space tool itself. lib/launch/setup-coverage.test.ts fails when a Space tool exists with neither an item nor a stated reason, so the list cannot fall behind the product. The pill stays after the launch overview completes, until the whole list is done. Splash and sales-funnel pages are the Website item today and need their own design pass.

verify.evidence: The Setup items exist, the post-publish list reads them, the coverage test is in place.
